articles.title_en: Expert Pozharskaya spoke about price traps on Russian beaches
articles.lead_en: Catering points can mislead tourists by indicating the cost of dishes not per serving, but per 100 grams, said the deputy head of the project of the Popular Front "For Borrowers' Rights"

articles.lead_raw: Точки общепита могут вводить туристов в заблуждение, указывая стоимость блюд не за порцию, а за 100 граммов, сообщила заместитель руководителя проекта Народного фронта "За права заемщиков"

articles.title_en: Russia’s Defense Ministry says air defenses downed more than 350 drones overnight. Two firefighters killed in Russia.
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck Russia’s Tambov region, damaging an apartment building, a library, and an arts school in Michurinsk, Tambov Governor Yevgeny Pervyshov said. There were no casualties.
